openings.claim: Extend the incumbent ledger with explicit record dependencies so final-review removals trigger reassessment of supported divergence claims.
openings.delta: Track which supplied records establish preceding equality, comparable stage inputs and unequal outputs, then recompute affected conclusions after removal.
openings.prediction: Removing a supporting transform record will retract or widen its dependent conclusion unless surviving evidence independently supports it; unrelated conclusions should persist.
openings.probe: Use the manifest and dictionary to align comparable boundaries. Retain the incumbent definite-stage rule: equal comparable inputs, unequal outputs and supported equality at preceding boundaries. Otherwise cite an unresolved interval and a feasible next check. Produce six reports within sixty minutes, log at most twelve manual inspections per pair, apply the stipulated removals during final review and reassess dependencies. Preserve manifest ordering despite the timestamp anomaly. Missing records and blank warnings establish neither nonexecution nor cause.
assumptions: The dictionary identifies comparable boundaries; ambiguity remains unresolved.

openings.claim: Prioritizing manual checks at the earliest unresolved boundary may improve useful narrowing within the inspection budget.
openings.delta: Add a conservative inspection queue to the incumbent workflow without changing its evidence threshold.
openings.prediction: Compared with ordinary review, prioritized review may yield narrower correct intervals per manual inspection; it may instead show no advantage when necessary digests are absent.
openings.probe: Assign ordinary and prioritized review to the supplied disjoint three-pair subsets. Prioritize existing records adjacent to the earliest unresolved boundary; stop inspecting a gap when no supplied record can resolve it. Keep all claims cited, separate mismatches from explanations and retain the twelve-inspection cap. Within the additional twenty minutes compare frozen outputs, coverage and inspection counts using the two sealed answer sheets, opened only after freezing. Report subset differences as a limitation.
assumptions: The supplied records may contain informative checks; narrowing is not guaranteed.

assessment: Both are ordinary extensions of the stipulated comparator and ledger. Predictions remain unmeasured; disjoint subsets cannot establish causal superiority.

lineage.reason: Preserve conservative boundary reporting while making removal-driven reassessment explicit.
